defense grid: the awakening.name: Defense Grid: The Awakening
defense grid: the awakening.short_description: Defense Grid: The Awakening is a unique spin on tower defense gameplay that will appeal to players of all skill levels. A horde of enemies is invading, and it's up to the player to stop them by strategically building fortification towers around their base.

street fighter iv.name: Street Fighter® IV
street fighter iv.short_description: Street Fighter® IV brings the legendary fighting series back to its roots by taking the beloved fighting moves and techniques of the original Street Fighter® II, and infusing them with Capcom's latest advancements in next generation technology.

call of duty: modern warfare 2.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 2 (2009)
call of duty: modern warfare 2.short_description: The most-anticipated game of the year and the sequel to the best-selling first-person action game of all time, Modern Warfare 2 continues the gripping and heart-racing action as players face off against a new threat dedicated to bringing the world to the brink of collapse.

braid.name: Braid
braid.short_description: This is the original version of Braid from 2009, which may not work well on newer systems. For an updated version of the game with nicer graphics, more levels and a large amount of developer commentary, see Braid, Anniversary Edition.

batman: arkham asylum.name: Batman: Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition
batman: arkham asylum.short_description: Experience what it’s like to be Batman and face off against Gotham's greatest villians. Explore every inch of Arkham Asylum and roam freely on the infamous island.

dragon age: origins.name: Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition
dragon age: origins.short_description: Explore a stunning world, make complex moral choices, and engage in bone-crushing combat against massive and terrifying creatures. The Ultimate Edition includes Dragon Age: Origins, Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening and all nine content packs.

left 4 dead 2.name: Left 4 Dead 2
left 4 dead 2.short_description: Set in the zombie apocalypse, Left 4 Dead 2 is a co-operative action horror FPS takes you and your friends through the cities, swamps and cemeteries of the Deep South, from Savannah to New Orleans across five expansive campaigns.

plants vs. zombies.name: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition
plants vs. zombies.short_description: Zombies are invading your home, and the only defense is your arsenal of plants! Armed with an alien nursery-worth of zombie-zapping plants like peashooters and cherry bombs, you'll need to think fast and plant faster to stop dozens of types of zombies dead in their tracks.

saints row 2.name: Saints Row 2
saints row 2.short_description: Saints Row 2 brings true freedom to open-world gaming. Players can play as who they want, how they want, and with whomever they want in this sequel to the much acclaimed and tremendously successful Saints Row.

mirror's edge.name: Mirror's Edge™
mirror's edge.short_description: In a city where information is heavily monitored, couriers called Runners transport sensitive data. In this seemingly utopian paradise, a crime has been committed, & you are being hunted. You are a Runner called Faith and this innovative first-person action-adventure is your story.

the maw.name: The Maw
the maw.short_description: The pinnacle of alien evolution, Maw is a cowardly fat blob concerned mostly with snacking and lounging. He can, however, absorb the traits of anything he eats, is virtually indestructible, and can grow to unlimited size. If he wasn't a danger to all life in the universe, he'd make the perfect pet.

f.e.a.r. 2: project origin.name: F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin
f.e.a.r. 2: project origin.short_description: Assume the role of Special Forces Sgt. Becket as your routine mission quickly turns into a fight for survival against the wrath of Alma Wade. As Alma's terrifying power surges out of control, your squad is forced to battle through an apocalyptic landscape in search of clues for how to destroy her!

x-blades.name: X-Blades
x-blades.short_description: In X-Blades, the player takes on the role of the enchanting heroine Ayumi, who survives a breathtaking dance of blades through the Hordes of Darkness. The long-haired beautiful anime, with her pistol blades and mind-blowing leaps, whirls and swirls from one fantastic level to the next.

perimeter 2: new earth.name: Perimeter 2: New Earth
perimeter 2: new earth.short_description: <p><i>Perimeter 2: New Earth</i> is the long-awaited sequel of the critically acclaimed RTS <i>Perimeter</i>. Ideas of territorial gameplay and landscape modification, introduced in the original game, are now realized on a new concept & technology level.

warhammer 40,000: dawn of war ii.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II - Anniversary Edition (Classic)
warhammer 40,000: dawn of war ii.short_description: All of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II in one package. Play the award-winning real-time strategy game in all its glory, including three full campaigns, six multiplayer factions, and a full co-op Last Stand mode with eight unique heroes.

puzzle quest: galactrix.name: Puzzle Quest: Galactrix
puzzle quest: galactrix.short_description: The puzzle game of the future has arrived! The original best-selling new Puzzle franchise is back in an all new dimension with its signature Match-3, turn based battles in an insanely addictive and masterful hybrid of RPG and Puzzle genres.

tom clancy's endwar.name: Tom Clancy's EndWar™
tom clancy's endwar.short_description: Live the thrilling career of an army commander and lead your army to victory in a massive online World War III! Take control of the U.S.-led Joint Strike Force, the European Enforcers Corps, or the Russian Spetsnaz Guards Brigade in a persistent ongoing World War.

necrovision.name: NecroVision
necrovision.short_description: War is Hell. NecroVision is a first-person shooter that takes gamers across the frantic battlegrounds of World War I and into a dark underworld of vampires, demons and dark magic.

watchmen: the end is nigh.name: Watchmen: The End is Nigh
watchmen: the end is nigh.short_description: The lines between good and bad have been blurred and crime and terror run rampant in the streets. command & conquer red alert 3: uprising.name: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3 - Uprising
command & conquer red alert 3: uprising.short_description: Red Alert 3: Uprising features four new mini-campaigns, giving players a deeper dive into the storyline's of the Soviets, the Allies, the Empire of the Rising Sun and a unique campaign centered on the origins of everyone’s favorite psionic Japanese schoolgirl commando, Yuriko Omega.

codename panzers: cold war.name: Codename: Panzers - Cold War
codename panzers: cold war.short_description: Tempelhof, Berlin, dawn of 8th April 1949.A major armed conflict is brewing between the Western powers and the Soviet bloc. The Red Army has been growing ever stronger since the end of World War II. With the growth of their army the Soviets realize that they hold the advantage, and are only waiting for the right moment to attack.

resident evil 5.name: Resident Evil 5
resident evil 5.short_description: This game is a port of the Games for Windows - Live version that was released in 2009. If you buy the Untold Stories Bundle here on Steam, it will be the same as upgrading to Resident Evil 5 Gold Edition.

grand ages: rome.name: Grand Ages: Rome
grand ages: rome.short_description: As Governor of a Roman Province in the time-honoured Roman Empire, its fortune very much lies in your hands. Choose one of five Roman noble families such as Caesar’s Julii with different abilities to accomplish the comprehensive missions.

dark sector.name: Dark Sector
dark sector.short_description: A third-person Action/Shooter that thrusts players into a sci-fi flavored nightmare scenario set in the post Cold War era.

wallace & gromit's grand adventures.name: Wallace & Gromit’s Grand Adventures
wallace & gromit's grand adventures.short_description: Enter the colorful world of West Wallaby Street in a series of four cracking adventures brought to you by Aardman Animations, the creators of the Wallace & Gromit animated films, and award-winning Telltale Games.

elven legacy.name: Elven Legacy
elven legacy.short_description: This sequel to Fantasy Wars continues its story after banishing the archdemon. The shadows of destruction begin to loom on the horizon once a human mage uncovers a dark and powerful secret dating back to the remote past of the Elven race.

ninja blade.name: Ninjas vs Samurais Card Chronicles: Blades of the Shinigami
ninja blade.short_description: Ninjas vs Samurais Card Chronicles: 死神の刃 is a beautiful story rich Jrpg, roguelike, card battling gameing. Combining both strategy & skill, players will need to craft unique decks & use their chosen heroes unique abilities, in hopes to restore balance & bring peace to this war torn land.

company of heroes: tales of valor.name: Company of Heroes: Tales of Valor
company of heroes: tales of valor.short_description: Company of Heroes®: Tales of Valor™ is the expansion to the Game of the Year winner and highest rated real time strategy franchise Company of Heroes®. Featuring new campaigns to overcome, units to command, and battlefields to conquer, Company of Heroes®: Tales of Valor™ delivers evolved gameplay mechanics and 3 episodic adventures...

demigod.name: Demigod
demigod.short_description: Set in a magical world where gods walk among mortals, Demigod blends action, strategy and role-playing elements into a thrilling new experience.

zeno clash.name: Zeno Clash
zeno clash.short_description: Zeno Clash is an action/fighting game set in a punk fantasy world. The game is played from a first person perspective and the combat is generally up close and brutal. Experience a deep storyline set in a fantastic world.

velvet assassin.name: Velvet Assassin
velvet assassin.short_description: Inspired by the fascinating story and unbreakable spirit of British secret agent Violette Szabo, players take control of Violette Summer, a beautiful World War II spy deep behind enemy lines with no support or official backing from the British Government.

stalin vs. martians.name: Stalin vs. Martians 4
stalin vs. martians.short_description: Stalin vs. Martians 4 is an unlikely sequel to the infamous Stalin vs. Martians game. secret files 2: puritas cordis.name: Secret Files 2: Puritas Cordis
secret files 2: puritas cordis.short_description: The sequel to the award winning adventure hit Secret Files Tunguska. Famine in Africa, floods in Southeast Asia, economic crisis in Europe, and civil wars in South America, the world is on the brink of disaster.

battlestations: pacific.name: Battlestations Pacific
battlestations: pacific.short_description: Experience one war through two epic sagas where you will be a part of history or change it. Relive some of the grandest and most critical naval battles of recent history and for the first time, choose to lead your fleet to a completely different ending...

killing floor.name: Killing Floor
killing floor.short_description: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest! Free updates, free special events and a ridiculous amount of fun!

bionic commando.name: Bionic Commando
bionic commando.short_description: The first true sequel to the classic 1988 Nintendo Entertainment System original, Bionic Commando sees the return of the bionically-enhanced Nathan "R.A.D." damnation.name: Damnation84
damnation.short_description: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

the polynomial: space of the music.name: The Polynomial - Space of the music
the polynomial: space of the music.short_description: Experience the music in a new way. Feel it pulse around you. The Polynomial is a 3D space shooter with unique, fractal based scenery that animates to the music.

red faction: guerrilla.name: Red Faction Guerrilla Steam Edition
red faction: guerrilla.short_description: Set 50 years after the climactic events of the original Red Faction, Red Faction: Guerrilla allows players to take the role of an insurgent fighter with the newly re-established Red Faction movement as they battle for liberation from the oppressive Earth Defense Force.

the sims 3.name: The Sims™ 3
the sims 3.short_description: The Sims 3: Create the perfect world with full customization at your fingertips. Refine personalities and help fulfill destinies.

prototype.name: Prototype™
prototype.short_description: You are the Prototype, Alex Mercer, a man without memory armed with amazing shape-shifting abilities, hunting your way to the heart of the conspiracy which created you; making those responsible pay. lego star wars iii: the clone wars.short_description: LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars will allow fans to explore endlessly and laugh their way through the Star Wars galaxy in the most humorous, accessible and action-packed LEGO game to date.

shift 2: unleashed.name: Shift 2 Unleashed
shift 2: unleashed.short_description: Bring the true driver’s experience to life with all the intensity and exhilaration of being behind the wheel!

spiral knights.name: Spiral Knights
spiral knights.short_description: Join the ranks of the Spiral Knights. Stranded on an alien world, you must explore the ever-changing Clockworks beneath its surface.

anomaly: warzone earth.name: Anomaly: Warzone Earth
anomaly: warzone earth.short_description: Lead an armored squad through the perils of this reversed tower defense action-strategy game!

mount&blade: with fire & sword.name: Mount & Blade: With Fire & Sword
mount&blade: with fire & sword.short_description: The standalone expansion for Mount & Blade! With Fire & Sword builds and expands upon the highly regarded combat system from Mount & Blade: Warband. Firearms have been introduced to the battlefield.

brink.name: Brink Of Death
brink.short_description: It is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and at most 4 players on the Brink of Death. Your goal is to defeat the killer doctor who feeds on fear in the cursed area. You'll need a lot of things, but don't stop destroying the scarecrows it draws on. Death is just the beginning.

the first templar.name: The First Templar - Steam Special Edition
the first templar.short_description: Uncover the mysteries behind the Templar Order! Steam Exclusive Edition includes bonus mission “The Arena”.

hydrophobia prophecy.name: Hydrophobia: Prophecy
hydrophobia prophecy.short_description: The ultimate edition of the jaw-dropping action-adventure game set onboard a floating city.

lego pirates of the caribbean: the video.name: LEGO® Pirates of the Caribbean: The Video Game
lego pirates of the caribbean: the video.short_description: LEGO® Pirates of the Caribbean: The Video Game is an action adventure game that brings the Pirates of the Caribbean world and all its colorful characters to life in LEGO Brick form. Players experience all the memorable scenes from all four films in the humorous and quirky LEGO Video Games style.

gatling gears.name: Gatling Gears
gatling gears.short_description: When the Empire begins its reign of destruction in a thirst for natural resources, it’s up to Max Brawley, a retired Gatling Gear pilot, to stop them.

terraria.name: Terraria
terraria.short_description: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

l.a. noire.name: L.A. Noire
l.a. noire.short_description: In his fight to climb the ranks and do what's right, LAPD detective Cole Phelps must unravel the truth behind a string of arson attacks, conspiracies, and brutal murders, battling the L.A. underworld and even members of his own department.

the witcher 2: assassins of kings.name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition
the witcher 2: assassins of kings.short_description: A time of untold chaos has come. Mighty forces clash behind the scenes in a struggle for power and influence. The Northern Kingdoms mobilize for war. But armies on the march are not enough to stop a bloody conspiracy...

dungeons & dragons: daggerdale.name: Dungeons and Dragons: Daggerdale
dungeons & dragons: daggerdale.short_description: Dungeons & Dragons: Daggerdale offers engaging "hack and slash" gameplay, bringing Dungeons & Dragons to life. Travel to the Dalelands of the Forgotten Realms, where the journey begins in the remote Desertsmouth Mountains.

frozen synapse.name: Frozen Synapse
frozen synapse.short_description: Brings the simultaneous turn-based strategy genre up-to-date and lets you give detailed, accurate orders to your squad.

hunted: the demon's forge.name: Hunted: The Demon’s Forge™
hunted: the demon's forge.short_description: It will take the combined efforts of two great warriors to explore menacing dungeons, overgrown ruins, and downtrodden towns … and discover the secrets of the Demon’s Forge.

red faction: armageddon.name: Red Faction®: Armageddon™
red faction: armageddon.short_description: Red Faction: Armageddon Path to War includes 4 new missions, 2 unlockable items and 10 new achievements!

alice: madness returns.name: Alice: Madness Returns
alice: madness returns.short_description: Alice: Madness Returns is a third-person, single-player, action adventure platformer. Visit the grim reality of Victorian London and travel to the beautiful yet ghastly Wonderland to uncover the root of Alice's madness.

duke nukem forever.name: Duke Nukem Forever
duke nukem forever.short_description: The King arrives with an arsenal of over-the-top weapons, giant explosions and pure unadulterated fun!

alien zombie megadeath.name: Alien Zombie Megadeath
alien zombie megadeath.short_description: Alien Zombie Megadeath is a gloriously intense platform shoot-em-up!

f.e.a.r. 3.name: F.E.A.R. 3
f.e.a.r. 3.short_description: F.E.A.R. 3 delivers all the hallmarks that define the F.E.A.R. brand: terrifying paranormal experience, frenetic combat and a dramatic storyline.

nancy drew: the captive curse.name: Nancy Drew®: The Captive Curse
nancy drew: the captive curse.short_description: A terrifying myth comes alive in Germany!

earth defense force: insect armageddon.name: Earth Defense Force: Insect Armageddon
earth defense force: insect armageddon.short_description: Thousands of giant insects and aliens once again ravage the earth, and only the Earth Defense Force can stop them.

sweatshop.name: Sweatshop Tycoon
sweatshop.short_description: A dark management tycoon where profit has consequences. Grow from basement to factory and choose profit over workers' rights. Survive on small margins and even smaller morals. Keep the state happy or face brutal inspections.

from dust.name: From Dust
from dust.short_description: Immerse yourself in a world as exotically beautiful as it is dangerous in this modern God-Game where Nature is the Star!

serious sam double d.name: Serious Sam Double D XXL
serious sam double d.short_description: Pile on the firepower with the revolutionary Gunstacker and fire all your weapons at once in a symphony of destruction!

achron.name: Achron
achron.short_description: As one of the survivors and humankind's first “Achronal” being, you must piece together what happened and unravel the mysteries surrounding the alien invasion.

tropico 4.name: Tropico 4
tropico 4.short_description: The world is changing and Tropico is moving with the times - geographical powers rise and fall and the world market is dominated by new players with new demands and offers - and you, as El Presidente, face a whole new set of challenges.

rock of ages.name: Rock of Ages
rock of ages.short_description: A rock-solid combination of rock-rolling action, deep strategy, and captivating art and music from different ages of history, this is a game of crush or be crushed!

wasteland angel.name: Wasteland Angel
wasteland angel.short_description: Wasteland Angel is a top-down twin-stick shoot ‘em up arena shooter. Fend off waves and waves of enemies and epic bosses as you try and survive in a post-apocalyptic America. Drive and shoot your way through the wasteland, protecting civilians, completing missions, and surviving another day.

warhammer 40,000: space marine.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition
warhammer 40,000: space marine.short_description: In Warhammer 40,000 Space Marine you are Captain Titus, a Space Marine of the Ultramarines chapter and a seasoned veteran of countless battles.

hard reset.name: Hard Reset Extended Edition
hard reset.short_description: Over-the-top destruction, loads of enemies & a beautifully realized cyberpunk setting. Hard Reset is here to shake up the shooter scene. Try the demo now.

red orchestra 2: heroes of stalingrad.name: Red Orchestra 2: Heroes of Stalingrad with Rising Storm
red orchestra 2: heroes of stalingrad.short_description: Contains full Rising Storm content as well!

renegade ops.name: Renegade Ops
renegade ops.short_description: Blast your way through enemy lines to defeat Inferno, a madman intent on global domination. Destruction just got awesome.

nuclear dawn.name: Nuclear Dawn
nuclear dawn.short_description: Explore war-torn post-apocalyptic landscapes and take fight against enemies using various weapons in this FPS/RTS hybrid.

the binding of isaac.name: The Binding of Isaac
the binding of isaac.short_description: Now 20% More Evil with the Free Halloween update!

worms ultimate mayhem.name: Worms Ultimate Mayhem
worms ultimate mayhem.short_description: Load your weapons and experience a whole new dimension in destructive turn-based cartoon action!

a game of thrones: genesis.name: A Game of Thrones - Genesis
a game of thrones: genesis.short_description: Immerse yourself into the battles and intrigues between the Houses that shaped the Kingdom of Westeros and keep your spot on the Iron Throne by any means.

unepic.name: UnEpic
unepic.short_description: Daniel was just an average guy. He was a great videogame player, a big fan of sci-fi movies, and a novice RPG player. In the midst of an RPG, he was teleported to a castle. At first, Daniel believed that he was having a massive hallucination.

orcs must die!.name: Orcs Must Die!
orcs must die!.short_description: Slice them, burn them, skewer them, and launch them - no matter how you get it done, orcs must die in this fantasy action-strategy game from Robot Entertainment.

dead rising 2: off the record.name: Dead Rising 2: Off the Record
dead rising 2: off the record.short_description: You are Frank West – photojournalist and original hero of the Dead Rising Willamette incident – taking center stage experiencing the re-imagined Fortune City outbreak.

mdk2 hd.name: MDK2 HD
mdk2 hd.short_description: Overhaul Games brings MDK2 back to the PC in incredible high definition, with enhanced graphics, sound, and gameplay. See the classic action platformer the way it was meant to be seen, heard, and played... on a PC!Kurt Hectic in his snazzy suit with ribbon chute is back to save the universe. This time he is teamed with the genius Dr.

might and magic heroes vi.name: Might & Magic: Heroes VI
might and magic heroes vi.short_description: Heroes VI is a fast-paced epic story where Angels plot to end -- once and for all -- an unfinished war with their ancient rivals, the Faceless.

dungeon defenders.name: Dungeon Defenders
dungeon defenders.short_description: Create a hero from one of four classes to save Etheria in this 4-player coop Tower Defense Action-RPG. Includes Steam exclusive Portal gun & TF2 familiars!

nancy drew: alibi in ashes.name: Nancy Drew®: Alibi in Ashes
nancy drew: alibi in ashes.short_description: Escape the Smoky Intrigue of a Hometown Inferno!

payday: the heist.name: PAYDAY™ The Heist
payday: the heist.short_description: Take on the role of a hardened career criminal executing intense, dynamic heists in constant pursuit of the next “big score”

serious sam: the random encounter.name: Serious Sam: The Random Encounter
serious sam: the random encounter.short_description: Choose your weapons and take aim at the most random Serious Sam adventure yet!

arcania: fall of setarrif.name: ArcaniA: Fall of Setarrif
arcania: fall of setarrif.short_description: Face the last challenge - determine destiny! A new threat casts its shadow over the Southern Isles. A mysterious demon, consumed by hatred, terrifies the population and pools his force against the coastal city of Setarrif. The dramatic situation exacerbates after a volcanic eruption in the mountains nearby.

battlefield 3.name: Battlefield 3™
battlefield 3.short_description: Enjoy total freedom to fight the way you want. Explore 29 massive multiplayer maps and use loads of vehicles, weapons, and gadgets to help you turn up the heat. Every second of battle gets you closer to unlocking tons of extras and moving up in the Ranks. So get in the action.

stronghold 3.name: Stronghold 3 Gold
stronghold 3.short_description: Set 10 years after the original, Stronghold 3: Gold follows the vengeful story of The Wolf in the third installment of the award-winning castle building series. The Wolf has cheated death become even more bitter and twisted. Build castles, rally your troops and save medieval England!

sonic generations.name: Sonic Generations Collection
sonic generations.short_description: Celebrate 20 years of Sonic in an all new adventure that delivers a definitive experience to Sonic fans new and old!

to the moon.name: To the Moon
to the moon.short_description: A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish.

escape goat.name: Escape Goat
escape goat.short_description: Escape Goat is a puzzle platformer where you take control of a goat, who has been imprisoned for witchcraft, and overcome traps and obstacles to escape the Prison of Agnus. Fear not, for with your supreme agility, sturdy horns, and the help of a magic mouse friend, you can turn the tables on foes and use the environment to your advantage.

stealth bastard.name: Stealth Bastard Deluxe
stealth bastard.short_description: Armed with only your wits and a pair of Stealthing Goggles, it’s your job to sneak your way through a deadly facility that’s determined to extinguish your fragile little life.

call of duty: modern warfare 3.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 3 (2011)
call of duty: modern warfare 3.short_description: The best-selling first-person action series of all-time returns with an epic sequel to the multiple GOTY award winner Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 2

lego harry potter: years 5–7.name: LEGO® Harry Potter: Years 5-7
lego harry potter: years 5–7.short_description: LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7 takes players through Harry Potter's heroic adventures in the Muggle and wizarding worlds.

assassin's creed: revelations.name: Assassin's Creed® Revelations
assassin's creed: revelations.short_description: Ezio Auditore walks in the footsteps of the legendary mentor Altair, on a dangerous journey of discovery and revelation.

saints row: the third.name: Saints Row: The Third
saints row: the third.short_description: Get ready for the most out-landish gameplay scenarios ever seen as the Third Street Saints take on the Syndicate!

anno 2070.name: Anno 2070™
anno 2070.short_description: Build your society of the future, colonize islands, and create sprawling megacities with multitudes of buildings, vehicles, and resources to manage.

cave story+.name: Cave Story+
cave story+.short_description: Run, jump, shoot, fly and explore your way through a massive action-adventure reminiscent of classic 8- and 16-bit games.

serious sam 3: bfe.name: Serious Sam 3: BFE
serious sam 3: bfe.short_description: Serious Sam 3: BFE is a prequel to the original indie fast action FPS and Game of the Year sensation - Serious Sam: The First Encounter!

flatout 3: chaos & destruction.name: FlatOut 3: Chaos & Destruction
flatout 3: chaos & destruction.short_description: Feel the adrenaline pulse through your veins as you barrel through insane race tracks against monster trucks, race cars, off road vehicles and much more.

satazius.name: SATAZIUS
satazius.short_description: The year is 2051. Location: SATAZIUS, a long-abandoned planet. The cruiser Agano was on patrol when it was attacked and stricken by a confederacy of space pirates that had established a base on SATAZIUS. The pirates attacked the Agano intending to steal the assault ship ‘Trafalgar’ that was stowed aboard the Agano, but the Trafalgar made...

metal dead.name: Metal Dead
metal dead.short_description: A hilariously terrifying adventure filled with laughs, blood, insanity, and of course... hordes of the undead.

postal iii.name: Postal III
postal iii.short_description: Good or Insane? The choice is yours. Following the Apocalyptic end to the Postal Dude’s week in Paradise, we follow him and his insane pitbull Champ as they emigrate to its appropriately named sister city, Catharsis.

star wars: the old republic.name: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™
star wars: the old republic.short_description: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ is a free-to-play MMORPG that puts you at the center of your own story-driven saga. Play as a Jedi, Sith, Bounty Hunter, or one of many other iconic STAR WARS roles in the galaxy far, far away over three thousand years before the classic films.

metal gear solid v: the phantom pain.name: METAL GEAR SOLID V: THE PHANTOM PAIN
metal gear solid v: the phantom pain.short_description: Ushering in a new era for the METAL GEAR franchise with cutting-edge technology powered by the Fox Engine, METAL GEAR SOLID V: The Phantom Pain, will provide players a first-rate gaming experience as they are offered tactical freedom to carry out open-world missions.

undertale.name: Undertale
undertale.short_description: UNDERTALE! The RPG game where you don't have to destroy anyone.

divinity: original sin enhanced edition.name: Divinity: Original Sin - Enhanced Edition
divinity: original sin enhanced edition.short_description: Gather your party and get ready for the kick-ass new version of GameSpot's PC Game of the Year 2014. With hours of new content, new game modes, full voiceovers, split-screen multiplayer, and thousands of improvements, there's never been a better time to explore the epic world of Rivellon!

the witcher 3: wild hunt.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition
the witcher 3: wild hunt.short_description: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer. Before you stands a war-torn, monster-infested continent you can explore at will. Your current contract? Tracking down Ciri — the Child of Prophecy, a living weapon that can alter the shape of the world.

80 days.name: 80 Days
80 days.short_description: 1872, with a steampunk twist. Phileas Fogg has wagered he can circumnavigate the world in just 80 days. Travel by airship, submarine, mechanical camel, steam-train and more. Race other players and a clock that never stops in TIME Magazine's Game of 2014.

nuclear throne.name: Nuclear Throne
nuclear throne.short_description: Nuclear Throne is a post-apocalyptic roguelike-like top-down shooter. Not 'the final hope of humanity' post-apocalyptic, but 'humanity is extinct and mutants and monsters now roam the world' post-apocalyptic. Can you reach the Nuclear Throne?

roche fusion.name: Roche Fusion
roche fusion.short_description: Roche Fusion is a retro, over the top space shooter. An all you can shoot buffet; fast paced and procedurally generated; with crazy waves of enemies, awesome upgrades and wicked boss-fights! Also: Explosions. Lots of explosions.

odallus: the dark call.name: Odallus: The Dark Call
odallus: the dark call.short_description: The old gods have forgotten this land. No one could save our people when darkness started spreading and collecting human souls for its army. Odallus is a classic exploration/action game, inspired by Ghosts’n Goblins, Demon’s Crest and Castlevania.

overwatch.name: Overwatch®
overwatch.short_description: Overwatch®, A FUTURE WORTH FIGHTING FOR! Overwatch® is an always-on and ever-evolving free-to-play, team-based action game set in an optimistic future, where every match is the ultimate 5v5 or 6v6 battlefield brawl.

owlboy.name: Owlboy
owlboy.short_description: Owlboy is a story-driven platform adventure game, where you can fly and explore a brand new world in the clouds! Pick up your friends, and bring them with you as you explore the open skies, in one of the most detailed adventures of this era.

tadpole treble.name: Tadpole Treble
tadpole treble.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure through sheet music in Tadpole Treble! Escape predatory piranhas, flirtatious tadpoles and more as you make your way back home. Shoot for the top of the leaderboards, or create your own stages and music in Composition Mode!

n++.name: No Man's Sky
n++.short_description: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.

divinity: original sin ii.name: Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition
divinity: original sin ii.short_description: The critically acclaimed RPG that raised the bar, from the creators of Baldur's Gate 3. Gather your party. Master deep, tactical combat. Venture as a party of up to four - but know that only one of you will have the chance to become a God.

ōkami hd.name: Okami HD
ōkami hd.short_description: Experience the critically acclaimed masterpiece with its renowned Sumi-e ink art style in breathtaking high resolution.

bayonetta.name: Bayonetta
bayonetta.short_description: PlatinumGames’ universally acclaimed action masterpiece finally comes to PC. Experience the over-the-top stylish action in 60fps at unlocked HD resolutions. The definitive way to play: being bad never felt so good.

opus magnum.name: Opus Magnum
opus magnum.short_description: Opus Magnum is the latest open-ended puzzle game from Zachtronics, the creators of SpaceChem, Infinifactory, and SHENZHEN I/O. Design and build machines that assemble potions, poisons, and more using the alchemical engineer’s most advanced tool: the transmutation engine!

linelight.name: Linelight
linelight.short_description: Linelight is an elegant puzzle game set in a world of lines.

red dead redemption 2.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
red dead redemption 2.short_description: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde Gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal, and fight their way across the rugged heartland in order to survive.

beat saber.name: Beat Saber
beat saber.short_description: Slash the beats, get moving, and experience the world's most popular VR rhythm game!* Duck, dodge, and flow through 300+ handcrafted songs from artists like Coldplay, Imagine Dragons, and Metallica. Play solo, compete online, or pass the headset at your next party. Jump in with 60+ songs included!

disco elysium.name: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
disco elysium.short_description: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

hades.name: Hades
hades.short_description: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from the creators of Bastion, Transistor, and Pyre.

half-life: alyx.name: Half-Life: Alyx
half-life: alyx.short_description: Half-Life: Alyx is Valve’s VR return to the Half-Life series. It’s the story of an impossible fight against a vicious alien race known as the Combine, set between the events of Half-Life and Half-Life 2. Playing as Alyx Vance, you are humanity’s only chance for survival.

crusader kings iii.name: Crusader Kings III
crusader kings iii.short_description: Love, fight, scheme, and claim greatness. Determine your noble house’s legacy in the sprawling grand strategy of Crusader Kings III. Death is only the beginning as you guide your dynasty’s bloodline in the rich and larger-than-life simulation of the Middle Ages.

spelunky 2.name: Spelunky 2
spelunky 2.short_description: Spelunky 2 builds upon the unique, randomized challenges that made the original a roguelike classic, offering a huge adventure designed to satisfy players old and new. Meet the next generation of explorers as they find themselves on the Moon, searching for treasure and missing family.

elden ring.name: ELDEN RING
elden ring.short_description: THE CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED FANTASY ACTION RPG. Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

persona 5 royal.name: Persona 5 Royal
persona 5 royal.short_description: Lead the Phantom Thieves of Hearts in this award winning, stylish turn-based RPG filled with dungeon crawling, party customization, strategic combat, and Persona fusion. Explore Tokyo, build relationships, battle Shadows, and infiltrate the minds of the corrupt to make them change their ways!

dwarf fortress.name: Dwarf Fortress
dwarf fortress.short_description: Build a fortress and try to help your dwarves survive against a deeply generated world. Keep your dwarves happy, grow their community and beware of digging too deeply. The deepest, most intricate simulation of a world that's ever been created.

the stanley parable: ultra deluxe.name: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe
the stanley parable: ultra deluxe.short_description: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe is an expanded re-imagining of 2013's The Stanley Parable. You will play as Stanley, and you will not play as Stanley. You will make a choice, and you will become powerless. You are not here to win. The Stanley Parable is a game that plays you.

god of war.name: God of War
god of war.short_description: His vengeance against the Gods of Olympus years behind him, Kratos now lives as a man in the realm of Norse Gods and monsters. It is in this harsh, unforgiving world that he must fight to survive… and teach his son to do the same.

chained echoes.name: Chained Echoes
chained echoes.short_description: Take up your sword, channel your magic or board your Mech. Chained Echoes is a 16-bit style RPG set in a fantasy world where dragons are as common as piloted mechanical suits.

the legend of heroes: trails from zero.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero
the legend of heroes: trails from zero.short_description: When Lloyd Bannings is assigned to Crossbell's Special Support Section, he and his new teammates must prove themselves as they fight to overcome the injustice of a city gripped by corruption.

baldur's gate 3.name: Baldur's Gate 3
baldur's gate 3.short_description: Baldur’s Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal, survival and sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.

street fighter 6.name: Street Fighter™ 6
street fighter 6.short_description: Here comes Capcom’s newest challenger! Street Fighter™ 6 launches worldwide on June 2nd, 2023 and represents the next evolution of the Street Fighter™ series! Street Fighter 6 spans three distinct game modes, including World Tour, Fighting Ground and Battle Hub.

against the storm.name: Against the Storm
against the storm.short_description: A dark fantasy city builder where you must rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains. As the Queen’s Viceroy, lead humans, beavers, lizards, foxes, and harpies to reclaim the wilderness and secure a future for civilization's last survivors.

dave the diver.name: DAVE THE DIVER
dave the diver.short_description: DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, singleplayer adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

videoverse.name: VIDEOVERSE
videoverse.short_description: Relive the days of the early internet and dive into this fictional video game era, where the 'Kinmoku Shark’ gaming system and its online social network 'Videoverse' were still popular…

metaphor: refantazio.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
metaphor: refantazio.short_description: After his assassination, the will of the late king decrees the next monarch to be elected by the people. Forge bonds and win over a kingdom divided in this award-winning fantasy RPG with turn-based and action combat, party customization with powerful Archetypes, and hours of exploration.

caves of qud.name: Caves of Qud
caves of qud.short_description: Inhabit a deeply-simulated science fantasy world and chisel through layers of thousand-year-old civilizations. Build a character from over a hundred mutations and cybernetics. The award-winning sandbox roguelike & RPG full of robots, deep lore, and sentient plants.

satisfactory.name: Satisfactory
satisfactory.short_description: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

ufo 50.name: UFO 50
ufo 50.short_description: UFO 50 is a collection of 50 single and multiplayer games that span a variety of genres, from platformers and shoot 'em ups to puzzle games, roguelites, and RPGs. Our goal is to combine a familiar 8-bit aesthetic with new ideas and modern game design.

animal well.name: ANIMAL WELL
animal well.short_description: Explore a dense, interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter beautiful and unsettling creatures, as you attempt to survive what lurks in the dark. There is more than what you see.

balatro.name: Balatro
balatro.short_description: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

tekken 8.name: TEKKEN 8
tekken 8.short_description: TEKKEN 8 is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games. Join the fight with over 32 characters and bear witness to the next installment in this epic saga. Get ready for the biggest and best TEKKEN game ever made!

hades ii.name: Hades II
hades ii.short_description: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

clair obscur: expedition 33.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
clair obscur: expedition 33.short_description: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

blue prince.name: Blue Prince
blue prince.short_description: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?

split fiction.name: Split Fiction
split fiction.short_description: Embrace mind-blowing moments as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction, a boundary-pushing co-op adventure.

hollow knight: silksong.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
hollow knight: silksong.short_description: Discover a vast, haunted kingdom in Hollow Knight: Silksong! Explore, fight and survive as you ascend to the peak of a land ruled by silk and song.

big walk.name: Big Walk
big walk.short_description: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

forza horizon 6.name: Forza Horizon 6
forza horizon 6.short_description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.

mina the hollower.name: Mina the Hollower
mina the hollower.short_description: Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

phantasmagoria.name: Phantasmagoria
phantasmagoria.short_description: Master storyteller Roberta Williams challenges you to experience the ultimate interactive nightmare.

the beast within: a gabriel knight myste.name: The Beast Within: A Gabriel Knight® Mystery
the beast within: a gabriel knight myste.short_description: Play as both Gabriel and Grace as they are dispatched to Munich to solve a series of mutilation murders thought to be the work of werewolves.

shogo: mobile armor division.name: Shogo: Mobile Armor Division
shogo: mobile armor division.short_description: Shogo is an anime-inspired first-person shooter. Fight on foot or pilot a giant mech in both open and urban levels. You will know the true power of giant robots!

dishonored.name: Dishonored
dishonored.short_description: Dishonored is an immersive first-person action game that casts you as a supernatural assassin driven by revenge. With Dishonored’s flexible combat system, creatively eliminate your targets as you combine the supernatural abilities, weapons and unusual gadgets at your disposal.

guild wars 2.name: Guild Wars 2®
guild wars 2.short_description: Guild Wars 2 is an award-winning online roleplaying game with fast-paced action combat, deep character customization, and no subscription fee required. Choose from an arsenal of professions and weapons, explore a vast open world, compete in PVP modes and more. Join over 16 million players now!

spelunky.name: Spelunky
spelunky.short_description: Spelunky is a unique platformer with randomized levels that offer a challenging new experience each time you play. Journey deep underground and explore fantastic places filled with all manner of monsters, traps, and treasure.
